tutor.q1: How much commission does FluentDoor take from my earnings?
tutor.q10: Can I teach more than one language on FluentDoor?
tutor.q11: How important are student reviews for my profile?
tutor.q12: What equipment do I need to start teaching?
tutor.q2: How do students book lessons with me? Do I reach out to them?
tutor.q3: Do I need to pay any subscription or extra fees to access platform features?
tutor.q4: Can I set my own hourly rate on FluentDoor?
tutor.q5: What is the difference between a Professional Teacher and a Community Tutor?
tutor.q6: What kind of support does FluentDoor provide for finding new students?
tutor.q7: What happens if a student cancels a lesson?
tutor.q8: Do I need to prepare lesson materials, or does FluentDoor provide them?
tutor.q9: How do I get paid for my lessons?
tutor.s1: FluentDoor charges a 15% commission on lesson fees, which is deducted before the earnings reach your wallet.
tutor.s10: Yes—if you are fluent in multiple languages, you can add them to your profile and offer lessons in each one.
tutor.s11: Very important—positive reviews help increase your visibility and trustworthiness, making it easier to attract more students.
tutor.s12: A computer or tablet with a stable internet connection, a good-quality microphone, and a webcam are the basic requirements. A quiet teaching space is also recommended.
tutor.s2: Students choose a time from your available calendar slots. You can decline booking requests. The platform algorithm promotes your profile based on activity and ratings.
tutor.s3: No—there are no extra charges. Some optional premium features like 'FluentDoor Plus' may exist, but basic teaching features are free.
tutor.s4: Yes—you choose your hourly rate (minimum around €5). Many start lower to build reviews and gradually increase rates.
tutor.s5: Professional Teachers usually hold formal credentials or teaching experience, whereas Community Tutors may not—but both create profiles, set rates, and teach lessons online.
tutor.s6: FluentDoor markets your profile, highlights new teachers, and displays active tutors to interested students. Engaging with the community also helps increase visibility.
tutor.s7: If the cancellation is within the allowed time window, the class is rescheduled or refunded to the student. If they cancel late, you may still receive partial or full payment.
tutor.s8: FluentDoor does not supply lesson content. Tutors are expected to prepare their own materials, though many share resources or use online tools during sessions.
tutor.s9: Payments are transferred to your FluentDoor Wallet and can be withdrawn via Payoneer, bank transfer, or other supported methods once the minimum balance is reached.
